snippet.title: MICHAEL JACKSON LIVE DUBLIN 🇮🇪 1997 SHORT CLIP
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson's HIStory World Tour came to Dublin, Ireland, on July 19, 1997, at the RDS Arena. Approximately 40,000 people attended the concert. During the show, 31-year-old Christine Dowling, who had Morquio syndrome, was invited on stage during the "Heal the World" performance. 

Here are some additional details about the Dublin concert: 

Venue: RDS Arena.

Date: July 19, 1997.
Attendance: 40,000.

Special Moment: Christine Dowling, a fan with Morquio syndrome, was invited on stage.

The concert was part of Michael Jackson's HIStory World Tour, which was his third and final world tour.

There are original flyers and DVDs available as memorabilia from the Dublin concert.

snippet.title: AMY WINEHOUSE EMA LIVE BACK TO BLACK EMAs 2007
snippet.description: The 2007 MTV Europe Music Awards (EMAs) ceremony, where Amy Winehouse performed and won an award, took place on November 1, 2007. The event was held at the Olympiahalle in Munich, Germany. Amy Winehouse won the "Artist's Choice" award and performed "Back to Black".

AMY WINEHOUSE FINAL EVER IMAGES LEADING UP-TO DEATH {14 YEAR ANNIVERSARY}
snippet.description:
Today marks 14 years since we lost one of the greatest ever voices of modern times, the anniversary of the death of the legendary Amy Winehouse. 
For context I added the pictures of the Belgrade concert as it was her last ever concert show albeit one that should NOT have went ahead. I firmly believe that had Amy not gone on to perform that night and cancelled she may still be with us today. The shame and guilt of that performance on Amy must’ve been unbearable and drink was the only way she could escape those feelings. 
It is really deflating and depressing I can’t find anymore phots of Amy in her final months, however I’ve added as much as I could find. I remastered the video to give more clarity and clearness to some of the photos and video overall. 
I hope you guys enjoy the video; do please like, share and subscribe, Much LOVE to of you ❤️🙏🏻
